method: Native Tauri display focused after a completed framebuffer capture. Guest dd reads four 24-byte Linux input_event records; od reads the 8-byte payload at offsets 16,40,64,88. The GUI console is used only to prepare/read the probe; tested keys are sent through the focused graphical canvas.

focus_release.method: Press Shift while canvas focused, click GUI Refresh before host Shift keyup, then read guest events

shutdown.note: GUI handle returned143 after Alt-F4; not claimed as clean exit. No diagnostic in captured native log.

limitations: Native check covers A and focus-loss Shift release, not every key mapping
Fault, overflow, retry and recovery behavior tested with mocked IPC
Disconnect or abrupt GUI termination cannot guarantee held-key releases
No graphical pointer or IME integration
Full-frame latency remains unsuitable for responsive desktop use
No release or complete milestone qualification
